name: Kashmir
description: Nestled in the northernmost realm of India, Kashmir is famed for its snow-capped peaks, pristine Dal Lake shikara rides, serene valleys of Gulmarg and Pahalgam, and rich saffron heritage. A dream destination for luxury, honeymoon, and nature lovers.
highlights: Shikara Ride & Houseboat Stay on Dal Lake
Gondola Cable Car Ride in Gulmarg
Betaab Valley & Aru Valley Exploration
Saffron Fields & Apple Orchards of Pampore
bestTimeToVisit: March to August (Spring/Summer) or Dec to Feb (Snowfall)

name: Leh-Ladakh
description: The cold desert of Ladakh offers one of the most dramatic landscapes on the planet — cerulean lakes like Pangong and Tso Moriri, ancient Buddhist monasteries perched on cliffsides, rugged Himalayan passes over 5,000 metres, and a silence that touches the soul.
highlights: Pangong Tso Lake & Sunrise Camping
Khardung La Pass (World's Highest Motorable Road)
Thiksey & Hemis Monastery visits
Nubra Valley Camel Safari on Double-Hump Bactrian Camels

name: Shimla & Manali
tagline: Queen of Hills & Valley of Gods
description: Shimla, the former summer capital of British India, charms with colonial-era architecture, toy train rides, and apple orchards. Manali captivates with snow-clad peaks, the Solang Valley adventure hub, and Rohtang Pass's breathtaking vistas.
highlights: UNESCO Kalka-Shimla Toy Train Ride
Solang Valley Paragliding & Snow Activities
Rohtang Pass (Permit Required) Excursion
Hadimba Temple & Old Manali Cafe Walk

name: Goa
description: Goa's golden beaches, Portuguese heritage churches, vibrant nightlife, Konkani cuisine, and lush Western Ghats spice plantations make it India's favourite year-round coastal escape for families, couples, and solo travellers alike.
highlights: North Goa: Calangute, Baga & Anjuna Beach
South Goa: Palolem & Butterfly Beach
Old Goa UNESCO Churches & Heritage Walk
Dudhsagar Waterfalls Jeep Safari

name: Rajasthan
description: Rajasthan is a living canvas of royal forts, opulent palaces, camel caravans, and vivid festivals. From the Pink City of Jaipur to the Blue City of Jodhpur, White City of Udaipur and the Golden City of Jaisalmer — every corner tells a regal story.
highlights: Amber Fort & City Palace, Jaipur
Mehrangarh Fort Jodhpur & Ghanta Ghar
Jaisalmer Desert Camel Safari & Overnight Camp
Udaipur Lake Palace & Pichola Sunset Boat Ride

name: Kerala
description: From mist-clad tea plantations in Munnar to serene backwater cruises in Alleppey and wildlife sanctuaries in Thekkady, Kerala offers an enchanting blend of tranquility, luxury ayurvedic wellness, and cultural riches.
highlights: Private Luxury Houseboat Cruise in Alleppey
Munnar Tea Estate Walk & Tasting
Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary Safari in Thekkady
Authentic Ayurvedic Spa & Wellness Retreats

name: Ooty & Coorg
description: Ooty's rolling Nilgiri hills, scenic toy train, and rose garden paired with Coorg's aromatic coffee estates, Abbey Falls, and Tibetan monastery create a lush hill station escape ideal for families and couples.
highlights: Nilgiri Mountain Railway UNESCO Toy Train Ride
Ooty Botanical Garden & Doddabetta Peak
Coorg Coffee & Spice Plantation Walk
Abbey Falls & Raja's Seat Sunset View

name: Andaman Islands
description: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands boast crystal-clear turquoise waters, pristine white beaches, stunning coral reefs, and the historic Cellular Jail. Perfect for scuba diving, snorkelling, sea walking, and island hopping.
highlights: Radhanagar Beach (Asia's Best Beach) — Havelock Island
Scuba Diving & Snorkelling at Elephant Beach
Cellular Jail National Memorial Light & Sound Show
Neil Island Glass-Bottom Boat Ride

name: Mount Abu
description: Mount Abu is Rajasthan's only hill station, nestled in the Aravalli ranges. Famous for the stunning Dilwara Jain Temples with intricate marble carvings, Nakki Lake boat rides, Guru Shikhar peak, and the spiritual Brahma Kumaris World Headquarters.
highlights: Dilwara Jain Temples — Marble Architecture Marvel
Nakki Lake Sunrise Boat Ride
Guru Shikhar Peak (Highest Point in Aravalli)
Trevor's Tank Crocodile & Wildlife Sanctuary
bestTimeToVisit: November to February or June to September

name: Golden Triangle Punjab
description: Punjab's golden wheat fields, the sacred Golden Temple in Amritsar — the world's largest free kitchen (Langar), Wagah Border Retreat Ceremony, and rich Punjabi cuisine make it a deeply moving cultural and spiritual experience.
highlights: Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) & Langar
Wagah–Attari Border Beating Retreat Ceremony
Jallianwala Bagh National Memorial Visit
Authentic Punjabi Cuisine & Dhaba Food Trail

name: Varanasi & Ayodhya
description: Varanasi, one of the world's oldest living cities, sits on the sacred Ganges. Evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, dawn boat rides through ancient ghats, Sarnath Buddhist stupa, and Kashi Vishwanath Corridor make it a profoundly spiritual journey.
highlights: Evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
Sunrise Boat Ride Through 84 Ghats
Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Corridor Tour
Sarnath Buddhist Stupa & Museum

name: Spiti Valley
description: Spiti Valley is a cold desert mountain valley hidden between India and Tibet. With an average altitude of 4,000 m, it offers stark raw beauty — ancient monasteries like Key & Tabo, the village of Kibber (one of the world's highest motorable villages), and the Chandratal Lake.
highlights: Key Monastery (Ki Gompa) at 4,166 m altitude
Chandratal — Moon Lake at 4,250 m
Hikkim & Komic — World's Highest Post Office & Village
Chicham Bridge — Asia's Highest Gorge Bridge
